description:
Map the real desktop monetization release path end to end across deployment-manager, scenario-to-desktop, landing-page-business-suite, scenario-to-cloud, and the prompt-manager deployment skills.

Clarify:
- which surface owns canonical approval state
- which surface owns release/build/version records
- which step actually publishes artifacts and update manifests
- where LPBS app/app-key/channel/release-note state is the source of truth
- which actions already exist in API, UI, CLI, and skills versus which are still implicit or manual

Output should be a concrete system contract and dependency map that later implementation items can follow instead of guessing.
name: desktop-release-control-plane-audit
title: Audit The Desktop Release Control Plane
